title: FlightAware sues Kalshi over flight cancellation data
summary: The legal action against Kalshi focused on trademark infringement and injury to its reputation in addition to citing state authorities comparing the company’s contracts to gambling.

title: Coinbase-backed Flowdesk secures full broker-dealer license in Dubai
summary: Flowdesk’s VARA approval follows its MiCA authorization in France as crypto firms build regulated operations across major global markets.

title: Nasdaq to acquire LeveL Markets in push toward ‘always-on’ markets
summary: Nasdaq’s acquisition of the third-largest US alternative trading system comes as the exchange operator expands into tokenized securities and longer trading hours.

title: Bitcoin drops to one-week low as retail buys gold at highest prices since June
summary: Bitcoin price action sank to one-week lows ahead of US CPI data, while retail investors piled into gold ETFs and XAU/USD hit its highest levels in nine weeks.

title: ADI Chain, Shipfinex partner to tokenize $500M vessel pipeline
summary: Shipfinex plans to bring 35 vessels onchain through ADI Chain as tokenization expands into the multitrillion-dollar maritime industry.

title: SharpLink reports $394M in Q2 net loss fueled by ETH decline
summary: SharpLink reported a net loss of $394 million in the second quarter of 2026, largely driven by Ether’s 23% decline during the quarter.

title: EToro to buy TradeZero as Q2 crypto revenue falls 30%
summary: Trading platform eToro will acquire TradeZero as part of its US expansion as it reported crypto-related revenue fell by about 30% compared to the second quarter of 2025.

title: Russia proposes exchange trading of Bitcoin, Ether and Tether’s USDT
summary: Russia’s central bank proposed allowing Bitcoin, Ether and USDT to trade on regulated exchanges, following a law signed by President Vladimir Putin last week.

title: Bitcoin sell pressure ‘closer to exhaustion’ after $4B USDT market-cap drop: CryptoQuant
summary: Bitcoin analysis suggested that sell pressure would not increase given the historically large contraction in USDT market cap over a 60-day period.

title: Coldcard hack losses: How investigators trace stolen Bitcoin
summary: The Coldcard hack has no definitive loss figure yet as investigators rely on victim reports and onchain analysis that produce varying estimates.
